description: The file defines the main React component for a Next.js frontend app involved in persona creation, editing, and orchestration. It handles file uploads, orchestrates backend API calls for persona generation, manages state and UI for different steps in persona lifecycle (initial, processing, draft, finalized), and includes UI elements like upload zones, persona editing panels, and progress indicators.

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Represents a professional experience entry associated with a persona.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: Defines the UI schema for persona data, including personal details, skills, experiences, and related info.

classes.name: UploadedFileData
classes.description: Represents an uploaded file with an ID and the file object.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Utility to convert unknown values to string arrays.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Converts a value to a pretty-printed JSON string with error handling.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable message from an error object.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials for display avatars from a label.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested properties in an orchestration response, returning value and path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs top-level and artifacts nested keys of an object for debugging.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Attempts to extract persona JSON object from orchestration record, considering multiple candidate paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON to the legacy UI PersonaData structure, handling various JSON formats.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component handling the entire persona workflow, including upload, orchestration, editing, and version management.
